metadata.description: Small Claude Code mods: a cloud-session band, a status bar for the desktop app, and a to-do band with your project's memories.

plugins.name: kit-cloud-pilot
plugins.description: Let Claude Code (CLI) run work in cloud sessions by itself: start them, track them on GitHub, wait for what they need and answer their questions with a signed reply.

plugins.name: kit-cloud
plugins.description: Your Claude Code cloud sessions above the prompt: working, asking, PR open, CI failed or silent, with links. Needs kit-cloud-pilot (installed with it).

plugins.name: kit-statusbar
plugins.description: A status bar for Claude Code in the desktop app and the CLI: repo, model, effort, context, account, session title, 5-hour and weekly limits.

plugins.name: kit-todos
plugins.description: Your project's open to-dos above the prompt, most urgent first, with Do it now / Draft buttons and the project's newest memories.
